review_findings.title: Wait for NSIS file removal before final failure
review_findings.details: The uninstaller exits while the installed executable can still be removed asynchronously. Poll for bounded disappearance after uninstaller exit, then retain a hard failure if the path remains. Do not weaken the absence assertion.

review_findings.title: Honor evidence path on verification errors
